components.name: Shiny Text
components.description: A band of light sweeps across the text, like light catching metal.

components.name: Gradient Text
components.description: Text filled with a flowing, seamlessly looping gradient. Optional animated border.

components.name: Blur Text
components.description: Words or letters come into focus from a blur, one after another. Click to replay.

components.name: Split Text
components.description: Letters (or words) rise into place one after another with a springy overshoot. Optional line mask for a pull-up reveal.

components.name: Decrypted Text
components.description: Characters scramble through random symbols, then lock into place one by one. Hover the lower lines to decode them again.

components.name: Typewriter
components.description: Types one or more strings, pauses, deletes and types the next, with a smoothly blinking cursor.

components.name: Rotating Text
components.description: Cycles through words with a per-letter staggered slide inside a pill that resizes to fit, or a blur flip.

components.name: Count Up
components.description: Numbers count to their target with easing, tabular digits, separators, decimals and prefixes. Changing the target animates from the current value.

components.name: Sliding Number
components.description: An odometer: each digit rolls vertically on a spring when the value changes, carrying past 9 like a real counter.

components.name: Glitch Text
components.description: Slices of the text jump sideways with red/cyan channel splits in short, violent bursts.

components.name: Fuzzy Text
components.description: Thin rows of the text jitter sideways every frame like a noisy signal; hover to crank up the fuzz.

components.name: Circular Text
components.description: Text set around a slowly rotating ring; hovering spins it faster.
components.code:
ui.add(CircularText::new("GLOWKIT • ANIMATED • RUST • ").center_text("✦"));
ui.add(CircularText::new("hover to slow down * ").on_hover(HoverSpin::SlowDown));

components.name: Scroll Velocity
components.description: Huge rows of text marquee in opposite directions forever; scroll over them to kick the speed (scrolling up reverses).

components.name: Wave Text
components.description: Letters bob on a travelling sine wave, optionally with a gradient riding the crest.
components.code:
ui.add(WaveText::new("Riding the wave").size(52.0));
ui.add(WaveText::new("with a gradient").colors(&theme.gradient));

components.name: Proximity Text
components.description: Letters near the pointer swell, thicken and shift color, nudging their neighbours aside.

components.name: True Focus
components.description: One word at a time snaps into focus inside animated corner brackets while the rest stay blurred.

components.name: Sparkles Text
components.description: Text with little four-pointed stars that pop in, twinkle and fade around it.

components.name: Morphing Text
components.description: Words melt into each other: the old one dissolves into a blur as the next condenses out of it.

components.name: Text Generate
components.description: A paragraph streams in word by word, each word fading out of a blur, like an AI response.
covers: Magic UI: Text Animate (blurIn by word)

components.name: Highlight Text
components.description: Animated emphasis drawn onto a phrase: marker swipe, underline, box, hand-drawn circle or strike-through.

components.name: Colorful Text
components.description: Each letter takes a color from a palette; every few seconds they reshuffle in a little blur-and-bounce wave.

components.name: Gradual Spacing
components.description: Letters start squeezed together and spread out to their natural spacing as they fade in.

components.name: Text Roll
components.description: Letters roll up and out while copies roll in from below, staggered. Holds while hovered; great for menus.

components.name: Shuffle Text
components.description: Each letter is a little slot-machine reel that spins through random letters and lands on the real one.

components.name: Scroll Reveal
components.description: A paragraph whose words brighten progressively from faint to full, driven by time, your own progress value or its scroll position.
components.code:
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("When does a man die? ...").scroll_linked());
ui.add(ScrollRevealText::new("Driven by a slider").progress(progress));

components.name: Line Shadow Text
components.description: Bold text with an offset shadow made of diagonal stripes that keep sliding through it.

components.name: Falling Text
components.description: Click and the words drop under gravity, tumble, bounce and pile up; drag through the pile to shove them, click again to send them home.

components.name: Animated Underline
components.description: Link text whose underline draws in from the left on hover and slides out to the right when the pointer leaves.

components.name: Scramble Hover
components.description: Letters dissolve into flickering symbols while hovered and resolve back left to right when the pointer leaves.

components.name: Box Reveal
components.description: A solid box sweeps across each line and slides away, uncovering text that rises in behind it.
components.code:
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("Magic UI.").size(64.0));
ui.add(BoxReveal::new("UI library for egui").delay(0.2).size(24.0));

components.name: Curved Loop
components.description: A text marquee flowing endlessly along a curved path. Drag it to scrub; throw it and it keeps running that way.
components.code:
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Welcome to glowkit")
    .curve(80.0)
    .speed(80.0));
ui.add(CurvedLoopText::new("Bend it like Rust")
    .curve(-40.0)
    .gradient(&palettes::MAGIC)
    .reverse(true));

components.name: Text Cursor
components.description: A trail of little text or emoji stamps pops out behind the pointer, wobbling and drifting as it fades. A ghost pointer draws loops when you are away.

components.name: Scroll Float
components.description: Letters float up out of the line, tall and squeezed at first, settling into shape one after another as the progress grows. Driven by time, a progress value or a scroll area.

components.name: ASCII Text
components.description: Big lettering redrawn as animated ASCII art: denser symbols where there is more ink, rippled by a flowing wave and tinted with a drifting gradient. The pointer bends it like a lens.

components.name: Scrambled Text
components.description: A paragraph whose letters dissolve into flickering symbols near the pointer and settle back into place after a moment.

components.name: Comic Text
components.description: Chunky comic-book lettering with a thick ink outline, a hard drop shadow and a halftone dot pattern, popping in with a springy twist.

components.name: Video Text
components.description: Huge letters that act as a window onto a moving scene (aurora, ocean, lava or plasma) flowing continuously across the whole word.

components.name: Text Reveal Card
components.description: Drag or hover across the card: left of a glowing divider, a hidden line of text shows through with twinkling stars.

components.name: Text Hover Effect
components.description: A huge outlined word; a radial gradient follows the pointer and lights the outline in color around it.

components.name: Pointer Highlight
components.description: A rectangle draws itself around a phrase while a pointer cursor glides to its corner, as if someone just highlighted it.
components.code: ui.add(PointerHighlight::new("The best way to grow is to ", "collaborate", "."));

components.name: Cover
components.description: Text in a box that turns into hyperspace on hover: streaking beams, sparkles, glowing corners and jittering text.

components.name: Number Pop In
components.description: Old digits sink away one by one; new ones rise from below, small and soft, overshoot the baseline and spring into place, staggered left to right.

components.name: Number Subtle Change
components.description: A counter that changes quietly: the old value drifts a few points away and blurs out as the new one drifts in, up for increases and down for decreases.

components.name: Text States Swap
components.description: A status line swaps its words with a tiny lift: the old text rises and blurs out, the new text rises into place from below.

components.name: Texts Reveal
components.description: Lines (or words) rise 12 points, un-blur and fade in on a long smooth curve, each a beat after the last; hiding is a quick fade.

components.name: Spinning Counter
components.description: Digits on little drums roll to the new value column by column, neighbours ghosting past; each lands with a pull-back and a springy snap past full size.

components.name: Thinking States
components.description: An AI status label with a soft highlight sweeping across muted text; each new state lifts the old words away and rises in.

components.name: Reasoning Stream
components.description: A card of agent reasoning that scrolls itself: every beat the text glides up a couple of lines on an ease-out, fading at the top and bottom, looping seamlessly.

components.name: Streaming Text
components.description: A reply streams in word by word, each word fading up out of a soft blur a beat after the last, with a caret riding the end.
components.code:
// feed it the text so far; only new words animate
ui.add(StreamText::new(&reply).width(380.0));

components.name: Flip Letters
components.description: Letters that roll over like a split-flap as the pointer passes, rippling to their neighbours with a springy overshoot.

components.name: Text Reel
components.description: A vertical stream of words under a fixed label; scroll or drag to inject momentum, reverse it, and let it ease back to cruising.

components.name: Ink Reveal
components.description: Every word starts faint and inks in as the scroll reaches it, with a soft leading edge; accented words light up with a highlighter swept behind them.

components.name: Petal Dissolve
components.description: A word erodes into tumbling red and white petals, then time runs backwards and every petal flies home to rebuild it.

components.name: Molten Text
components.description: A headline filled with churning molten metal: domain-warped lava, bevelled letter edges and a heat glow.

components.name: Chrome Text
components.description: Liquid chrome lettering: a sky-horizon-ground environment reflected in bevelled type, rippling, with a sweeping glint.

components.name: Grain Text
components.description: A headline filled with a slow drifting gradient of light under real per-pixel film grain.

components.name: Dither Text
components.description: A headline printed in four inks through an ordered-dither screen, with a band of light sweeping across it.

components.name: Aurora
components.description: Flowing curtains of northern light that drift and shimmer, fading into the background.

components.name: Particles
components.description: Drifting particles with depth, optional constellation links and pointer repulsion.

components.name: Squares Grid
components.description: An endlessly scrolling grid; the hovered square fills in and fades as you move on.

components.name: Dot Grid
components.description: A field of dots that bulges away from the pointer and springs back with a wobble. Click for a shockwave.
covers: Aceternity UI: Grid and Dot Backgrounds

components.name: Grid Pattern
components.description: Thin grid lines with squares fading in and out at random, a hover highlight and an optional skew.
covers: Aceternity UI: Grid and Dot Backgrounds

components.name: Retro Grid
components.description: A perspective grid floor scrolling toward the viewer, fading at the horizon.

components.name: Flickering Grid
components.description: A grid of tiny squares each flickering to random opacities, like a quiet LED panel.

components.name: Meteors
components.description: Meteor streaks with glowing heads and fading tails falling diagonally at random speeds.

components.name: Shooting Stars
components.description: Twinkling stars with shooting stars streaking across every couple of seconds.

components.name: Background Beams
components.description: Faint curved paths sweeping across the area with pulses of colored light racing along them.

components.name: Wavy Background
components.description: Thick, blurred ribbons of color undulating like slow ocean waves.

components.name: Waves
components.description: Dozens of thin lines warped by flowing noise; the pointer drags them and they spring back.

components.name: Threads
components.description: Fine threads fanning out from a bundle into flowing, rippling strands that lean toward the pointer.

components.name: Silk
components.description: Smooth, undulating folds of shaded silk with soft specular highlights.

components.name: Iridescence
components.description: An oily, iridescent rainbow film that swirls and shifts; the pointer stirs it.

components.name: Swirl
components.description: Psychedelic paint swirling into a slowly spinning vortex with marbled bands.

components.name: Liquid Metal
components.description: Rippling liquid chrome with flowing reflections; the pointer sends ripples through it.

components.name: Plasma
components.description: Classic demoscene plasma: interfering sine fields mapped to a glowing, looping palette.

components.name: Lightning
components.description: A crackling bolt with a white-hot core, wide glow and flickering branches.

components.name: Orb
components.description: A glowing ring of colored light with a breathing edge that ripples and spins faster on hover.

components.name: Warp Speed
components.description: Hyperspace star streaks rushing toward the viewer. Press and hold to engage warp.

components.name: Galaxy
components.description: A slowly rotating spiral galaxy with a bright core and colorful arms. Stars scatter from the pointer.

components.name: Letter Glitch
components.description: A wall of monospace letters constantly glitching to new characters and colors, with a vignette.

components.name: Matrix Rain
components.description: Columns of glyphs raining down with bright heads and fading trails.

components.name: Ripple
components.description: Concentric circles breathing in a staggered wave, fading toward the bottom.

components.name: Spotlight
components.description: Volumetric light rays fanning down from above, swaying and shimmering, leaning toward the pointer.

components.name: Lamp
components.description: A bright bar of light widening into view and casting a fan of colored light upward.

components.name: Vortex
components.description: Hundreds of glowing particles swirling into a vortex with short colorful trails.

components.name: Gradient Blobs
components.description: Big soft blobs of color drifting and blending like a lava lamp, one following the pointer.

components.name: Mesh Gradient
components.description: A smoothly animated four-color mesh gradient with organic swirl and distortion.

components.name: Snowfall
components.description: Gently falling snow with depth: distant flakes small and slow, near ones big and swaying.

components.name: Grain Noise
components.description: Animated film grain overlay that gives gradients an analog texture (right half).

components.name: Background Boxes
components.description: A skewed isometric grid of boxes that light up in random colors under the pointer.

components.name: Beams
components.description: Tall columns of soft light with luminous texture flowing down them; rotate for a diagonal look.

components.name: Hex Grid
components.description: A honeycomb of hexagons with random pulses, a rolling wave of light and a pointer glow.

components.name: Liquid Ether
components.description: A real-time fluid simulation: moving the pointer stirs glowing eddies of color that curl, mix and slowly fade. A ghost pointer keeps it alive.

components.name: Grid Scan
components.description: A wireframe grid tunnel receding into the distance, swept by a glowing scan frame that lights up the lines it passes. The view leans toward the pointer.

components.name: Prismatic Burst
components.description: Rays of rainbow light bursting from the center, rotating, flickering and breathing, with shock rings rippling outward.

components.name: Grid Motion
components.description: A tilted wall of tiles whose rows slide in opposite directions as the pointer moves, each with its own lag, for a deep parallax feel.

components.name: Laser Flow
components.description: A laser beam falls from the top and splashes across a surface, wrapped in luminous fog that curls outward and up.

components.name: Metallic Paint
components.description: A shape or logo filled with flowing liquid metal: rippling chrome bands, a bevelled rim and a highlight that follows the pointer.

components.name: Background Lines
components.description: Long flowing curves sweep across the area, drawing themselves in, lingering and erasing again, each on its own rhythm and in its own color.

components.name: Dotted Map
components.description: A world map drawn as a grid of dots, with glowing arcs flying between cities one after another and markers rippling where they land.

components.name: Meta Balls
components.description: Organic blobs that merge and split like liquid, colored by the dominant blob; one follows the pointer.
components.code:
ui.add(MetaBalls::new().count(9));
// behind other content: MetaBalls::new().paint_at(ui, rect, pointer_pos)

components.name: Ball Pit
components.description: Glossy balls with gravity, collisions and bounce; the pointer shoves them around and an invisible hand stirs them when idle.

components.name: Ripple Grid
components.description: Grid lines rippling with waves from the center and the pointer, crests lit in the accent color.

components.name: Dark Veil
components.description: A dark, slowly flowing veil of tinted light, like light through smoke.

components.name: Color Bends
components.description: Bands of vivid color that bend and flow, leaning toward the pointer.

components.name: Gradient Blinds
components.description: Venetian-blind slats of flowing gradient, each lit across its width, with a spotlight that follows the pointer.

components.name: Pixel Blast / Dither
components.description: Animated noise or waves quantized with a 4x4 Bayer ordered dither into pixels, dots or diamonds; ripples burst from the pointer.

components.name: Faulty Terminal
components.description: A glitchy green CRT: flickering glyphs under a brightness wave, scanlines, rolling interference and row glitches.

components.name: Fluted Glass
components.description: A picture behind reeded glass: each rib is its own lens holding a squeezed slice of the image, smeared into spikes, bending harder near the pointer.

components.name: Halftone Logo
components.description: A logo built from a rotated halftone dot screen with a wave of ink rolling through the dots.

components.name: Warp Grid
components.description: A fine grid that bends into a gravity well around a dark sphere under the pointer, glowing where it is pulled hardest.

components.name: Tornado
components.description: A strand vortex: hundreds of helical lines pinch into a waist and flare into a swirling floor, with motes and comets riding the funnel; the pointer parts the strands.

components.name: Accretion Disc
components.description: A black hole: thousands of particles orbit an occluding core along glowing log-spiral lanes, with faint polar jets. Drag to orbit the camera.

components.name: Light Cables
components.description: A bundle of glowing fibre cables rising from a wide fan, folding through one bend into a bright point, with light pulses running up them; the cables lean toward the pointer.

components.name: Wire Terrain
components.description: An endless flight down a wireframe valley toward a banded horizon sun, with hidden-line ridges; the pointer steers the camera.

components.name: Ribbon Glow
components.description: Layered ribbons of light sweep across the frame, twisting as they go and bending into a bright swirl around the pointer.

components.name: Matrix Junction
components.description: Glowing beams converge from every edge on a bright node that throws jittered lightning arcs toward the pointer.

components.name: Cloud Sky
components.description: An animated sky: cumulus clouds drift on two parallax layers under a cirrus veil, with a low sun glow; the pointer turns the wind. Dusk palette on dark themes.

components.name: Still Sunset Meadow
components.description: A ground-level voxel meadow at sunset: square sun, drifting block clouds, a blocky treeline and swaying cube grass and pixel flowers with a soft out-of-focus foreground.

components.name: Glimmer Vale
components.description: A night meadow of rolling hills made of twinkling peach-to-violet glitter under a periwinkle sky, with blooming crests and soft daisies drifting in the foreground.

components.name: Shimmer Button
components.description: A dark pill with a spark of light racing around its border and an inner glow that rises on hover.

components.name: Shiny Button
components.description: A subtle surface button whose label and border catch a band of light sweeping across.

components.name: Rainbow Button
components.description: A high-contrast button with a flowing rainbow border and a blurred rainbow glow pooled beneath it.

components.name: Pulsating Button
components.description: A solid call-to-action that sends soft rings of color pulsing outward like a heartbeat.

components.name: Ripple Button
components.description: Material-style ink ripples spread from wherever you click, clipped to the button's rounded shape.

components.name: Interactive Hover Button
components.description: A dot beside the label swells to fill the pill on hover while a new label and arrow slide in.
components.code:
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Book a demo"));
ui.add(InteractiveHoverButton::new("Hover me").hover_label("Let's go"));

components.name: Moving Border
components.description: A glowing blob of light endlessly orbits the button's thin border.

components.name: Hover Border Gradient
components.description: A highlight circles the pill's border; on hover the light spreads over the whole border in color.

components.name: Star Border
components.description: Two stars of light glide along the top and bottom edges in opposite directions.

components.name: Magnetic Button
components.description: The button is pulled toward the pointer as it approaches and springs back when it leaves.

components.name: Glow Button
components.description: A glossy gradient pill floating on a breathing pool of its own colored light; it lifts on hover.

components.name: Neon Button
components.description: An outlined neon tube with glowing text that occasionally flickers, and floods with light on hover.

components.name: Liquid Fill Button
components.description: Liquid with a wavy surface rises inside the outline on hover, flipping the label color as it passes.

components.name: Stateful Button
components.description: Idle, then a spinner while loading, then a drawn check mark on success, resizing smoothly between states.

components.name: Animated Subscribe Button
components.description: A toggle that slides between two labels, gaining a check mark and a new color when active.

components.name: Copy Button
components.description: Copies text to the clipboard; the copy icon morphs into a check mark, then back.
components.code:
ui.add(CopyButton::new("cargo add glowkit"));
ui.add(CopyButton::new("npm i glowkit").label("Copy"));

components.name: Particle Burst Button
components.description: Click to burst confetti, sparkles and dots out of the button (hold to keep spraying).

components.name: 3D Push Button
components.description: A chunky key you physically push: it pops up on hover and sinks on press with a bouncy spring.

components.name: Pixel Button
components.description: A retro 8-bit button with stair-stepped corners, a chunky bevel and a pixel drop shadow.

components.name: Gradient Outline Button
components.description: A transparent button outlined by a rotating gradient that floods the button on hover.

components.name: Arrow Slide Button
components.description: On hover the label nudges aside and the arrow chip shoots its arrow out while a new one slides in.

components.name: Glass Icons
components.description: Frosted glass tiles floating over tilted, vividly colored backplates; hover swings the plate and lifts the glass.

components.name: Script Copy Button
components.description: An install command with package-manager tabs and a copy button whose clipboard morphs into a check with a 'Copied!' bubble.

components.name: Animated Theme Toggler
components.description: A sun that morphs into a crescent moon; switching sweeps a circular reveal of the new theme across the area.

components.name: Unfurl
components.description: A parchment button that levitates, tips into a rolled scroll and drops its bottom roller; the charter inks itself in line by line and a wax seal stamps it shut.

components.name: Liquid Glass Button
components.description: Glass pills that blur and bend what is behind them like a thick lens, with rim highlights chasing the pointer.

components.name: Venom Button
components.description: A glossy black goo button: liquid strands stretch out to wrap a cartoon glove cursor when it comes close, then snap back with a wobble when you pull away.

components.name: Spider Button
components.description: A glossy red pill with corner cobwebs that shoots sagging web lines at the pointer, splats a web on click and snaps back when you pull away.

components.name: Velour Bolster
components.description: A velvet pill button that inflates into a soft cushion under the pointer, with grazing-angle sheen; it jiggles as you move, dents when pressed and settles flat.

components.name: Expanding Arrow Button
components.description: A dark pill with a bright arrow block that swallows the button on hover, its dotted chevron turning into a marching train.
components.code:
if ui.add(ExpandingArrowButton::new("Book a demo")).clicked() { /* go */ }
ui.add(ExpandingArrowButton::new("Get started").accent(egui::Color32::from_rgb(125, 211, 252)));

components.name: Border Beam
components.description: A comet of light travels around the border, fading from one color to another along its tail.

components.name: Shine Border
components.description: A band of multi-colored light drifts diagonally around the card's border.

components.name: Magic Card
components.description: A spotlight follows the pointer inside the card while the border lights up in a gradient around it.

components.name: Spotlight Card
components.description: A dark card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, optionally revealing a dot grid.

components.name: Tilt Card
components.description: The card tilts in 3D toward the pointer with real perspective, a moving glare and parallax content.

components.name: Glare Card
components.description: A diagonal streak of glare sweeps across the card on hover, with a soft sheen under the pointer.

components.name: Neon Gradient Card
components.description: A card wrapped in an animated two-tone gradient border that bleeds a big neon glow around it.

components.name: Glowing Border Card
components.description: The border lights up in a multi-color arc on the side facing the pointer, gliding around as it moves.

components.name: Encrypted Card
components.description: Scrambled characters are revealed over a glowing gradient in a circle around the pointer.

components.name: Pixel Card
components.description: Shimmering pixels fill the card on hover, spreading out from the center.

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: A frosted-glass card with a translucent fill, a light-catching rim and a soft shadow.

components.name: Wobble Card
components.description: A bold card wobbles toward the pointer on a springy band while its content drifts the other way.

components.name: Card Hover Effect
components.description: A soft highlight slab slides between cards in a grid, following the pointer.

components.name: Hover Lift Card
components.description: The card rises toward you on hover: a deeper shadow, an accent glow and a warmer border.

components.name: Focus Cards
components.description: The hovered card stays in focus while the others shrink back, dim and haze over.

components.name: Electric Border
components.description: A jittery, crackling border of electricity with layered glow.

components.name: Animated Gradient Border
components.description: A conic gradient keeps rotating around the border, optionally with a matching glow.

components.name: Marching Border
components.description: Dashes march around the border like a selection marquee or a drop zone.

components.name: Magic Bento
components.description: A bento grid where a spotlight follows the pointer and lights card borders; the hovered card tilts and sparkles with particles.

components.name: Chroma Grid
components.description: Profile tiles rendered in grayscale, with a circle of full color that follows the pointer across the grid.

components.name: Profile Card
components.description: A holographic trading-card profile that tilts toward the pointer while rainbow foil and a glare slide across it.

components.name: Glass Surface
components.description: A refracting glass panel: the backdrop bends and compresses toward its rim with color fringes and specular edges.

components.name: Fluid Glass
components.description: A liquid glass lens that glides after the pointer, magnifying and bending everything beneath it with rainbow edges.

components.name: Decay Card
components.description: A poster card whose picture tears and ripples with turbulence as the pointer moves over it, then slowly heals.

components.name: Pixel Transition
components.description: A card that swaps to its second face through a pixel dissolve: squares pop in at random, then away again.

components.name: Direction Aware Hover
components.description: A card whose caption overlay slides in from the edge the pointer entered through, and leaves the way it exits.

components.name: Glowing Stars Card
components.description: A card with a grid of tiny stars where random ones softly glow; more of them light up on hover.
components.code: ui.add(GlowingStarsCard::new("Next-gen rendering", "Crisp, animated UI on every platform."));

components.name: Canvas Reveal Effect
components.description: On hover a flickering dot-matrix ripples out from the center of the card while the icon lifts and the title appears.

components.name: 3D Pin
components.description: A card that tilts back in perspective on hover while a pin rises from its center with a label and pulsing rings.

components.name: Split Showcase
components.description: Two partner cards joined into one capsule by a dotted seam; the hovered half springs outward and rounds its inner corners.

components.name: Crumple Reveal
components.description: Balls of screwed-up paper on a desk; click one and it smooths out into the letter or photo it was, still faintly creased.

components.name: Elastic Frame
components.description: A rounded frame drawn as an elastic string: bring the pointer to an edge and it plucks outward into a glowing veil, then springs back with a wobble.

components.name: Card Bookmark
components.description: Cards cut like bookmarks with silky wave-ribbon art; the active one fills with its colour, lifts and glows while the others wait in the dark.

components.name: Holo Card
components.description: A holographic foil card that tilts toward the pointer in 3D, its thin-film sheen sliding with the angle.

components.name: Quote Deck
components.description: A testimonial deck fanned across the width: the focused quote upright, the rest leaning away, shrinking and dimming.
components.code:
let quotes = vec![Quote::new("Every detail was argued for.", "Mira Okafor", "Design lead", "Northwind"), /* ... */];
ui.add(QuoteDeck::new(&quotes).lean(1.0).autoplay(3.6));

components.name: Story Deck
components.description: Customer stories beside a deck of portrait cards you can throw; autoplay runs with a progress ring round the next button.
components.code:
let stories = vec![Story::new("We shipped in half the time.", "Ana Ruiz", "CTO, Brightline", "2x", "faster releases"), /* ... */];
ui.add(StoryDeck::new(&stories).autoplay(5.0));

components.name: Project Folder
components.description: A folder with pastel pages peeking out: hover and they fan up on rippling springs, press and they slide out into a row as the frosted front sinks.

components.name: Wallet Card
components.description: A wallet card whose balance rolls like an odometer when it changes, folds into dots behind the eye toggle, and carries a gain or loss pill that flips with it.
components.code:
let mut balance = 12_480.32;
ui.add(WalletCard::new(&mut balance).name("Main Wallet"));

components.name: Click Spark
components.description: Lines of light burst outward from every click. Wraps any area without stealing its clicks.

components.name: Click Ripple
components.description: Concentric rings ripple out from each click like a drop hitting water.

components.name: Pointer Trail
components.description: A glowing comet tail chases the pointer and shrinks away when it stops.

components.name: Ribbons
components.description: Silky ribbons chase the pointer on springs of different stiffness, weaving around each other.

components.name: Pixel Trail
components.description: Cells of an invisible grid light up under the pointer and fade out, leaving a pixelated trail.

components.name: Card Trail
components.description: Moving the pointer drops a trail of cards that pop in, tilt and shrink away (image trail).

components.name: Blob Cursor
components.description: Gooey blobs chase the pointer with growing lag and melt into each other like liquid.

components.name: Smooth Cursor
components.description: A custom cursor glides after the pointer on a spring, turning to face its direction of travel.

components.name: Following Pointer
components.description: A collaborator-style pointer with a name tag that trails the cursor over a card.
components.code:
let card = ui.add(my_card).rect;
FollowingPointer::new("Ada Lovelace").color(hex("#0EA5E9")).show(ui, card);

components.name: Crosshair
components.description: Hairlines track the pointer across the area, with an intersection ring and live coordinates.

components.name: Target Cursor
components.description: Spinning corner brackets follow the pointer and snap around whatever target it hovers.

components.name: Magnet
components.description: Wraps any content and pulls it toward a nearby pointer, springing back when it leaves.

components.name: Confetti
components.description: Confetti bursts from a point, tumbles in 3D and flutters down. Fire it from code or on click.

components.name: Fireworks
components.description: Rockets streak up and burst into glowing, falling sparks. Click to launch your own.

components.name: Sticker Peel
components.description: A die-cut sticker you drag to peel: the corner folds back along a crease, showing its paper back and a curl shadow.

components.name: Magnet Lines
components.description: A grid of short lines that all swivel to point at the pointer, glowing in the accent color nearby.

components.name: Shape Blur
components.description: Soft, out-of-focus outlines that snap into crisp focus wherever the pointer gets close.

components.name: Lens
components.description: A magnifying glass over any painted scene: the content is re-painted larger inside a glassy circular lens.

components.name: Mask Reveal
components.description: A circular mask follows the pointer and reveals an alternate version of the content underneath; it swells on hover.

components.name: Animated Tooltip
components.description: Overlapping avatars; the hovered one lifts and a name tooltip pops above it, swinging with the pointer on a loose spring.
components.code:
let team = [Person::new("Sarah Chen", "Product Designer", hex("#8B5CF6"), hex("#EC4899")), /* ... */];
ui.add(AnimatedTooltip::new(&team));

components.name: Scratch To Reveal
components.description: A shimmering foil you scratch away with the pointer; past 50% the rest dissolves and it reports `revealed`. Self-scratches when idle.

components.name: Compare Slider
components.description: Before / after comparison of two painted scenes with a draggable divider and grab handle; sweeps on its own when idle.

components.name: Hover Image List
components.description: Big project titles; hovering one summons a photo that trails the pointer on a spring, tilting as it moves and sliding to the next image.

components.name: Ink Trail
components.description: A surface the cursor paints into: a glowing trail that drifts on a slow noise current and fades, like an ember on dark themes and wet ink on light ones.

components.name: Dither Lens
components.description: A photograph that turns into an ordered-dither print inside a ragged, flickering zone that follows the pointer.

components.name: Mosaic Trail
components.description: A field of tiny greyscale thumbnails that swell and bloom into colour along the pointer's path, then shrink back to dots.

components.name: Cursor Ring Field
components.description: A field of scattered capsules lit by a soft ring trailing the pointer: capsules on the ring brighten, turn and get pushed outward, then drift back.

components.name: Fluid Trail
components.description: The pointer stirs a small real-time fluid simulation, leaving glowing, color-cycling dye that curls and fades behind it.

components.name: Hover Image Reveal
components.description: A list of large names; hovering a row floats an image window that follows the pointer on a spring, tilts with its speed and swaps image per row.

components.name: Card Stack
components.description: A deck of photos that fans out as you reach it: hover draws a card up, click flips it into the middle.

components.name: ASCII Wake
components.description: A cube drawn in ink dots; the pointer drags a wake of characters through it that cools back to dots, and a press sends a ring out.

components.name: Wake Slider
components.description: A range made of thin bars with no thumb; drag fast and the bars you sweep past spring up in a wake behind the hand.

components.name: Folding Bill
components.description: A banknote simulated as cloth: grab it, drag it and fold it over itself; plain or with an engraved print.

components.name: Heat Map
components.description: Gray dots that melt into a glowing heat map under your cursor; press for the next shape.

components.name: Generate
components.description: Press Generate and an image resolves under frosted glass, broad shapes first.

components.name: Image Accordion
components.description: Hover a photo strip and it opens wide while its neighbours give way around it.

components.name: Magnetic Select
components.description: Press an option and it swells into an iridescent orb as the rest are pushed out of its way.

components.name: Checklist
components.description: Tick a task and the box pops full, the check draws itself in and the words strike out.
components.code:
let mut tasks = vec![TodoItem::new("Water the ferns"), TodoItem::new("Reply to Ana")];
ui.add(TaskChecklist::new(&mut tasks).bounce(50.0).corner(20.0).box_size(18.0));

state.name: tasks
state.init: vec![TodoItem::new("Water the ferns"), TodoItem::new("Reply to Ana")]
state.decl: let mut tasks = vec![TodoItem::new("Water the ferns"), TodoItem::new("Reply to Ana")];

components.name: Liquid Toggle
components.description: A switch whose droplet stretches as it slides across the track and snaps round at the end.
components.code:
let mut on = false;
ui.add(LiquidToggle::new(&mut on).speed(50.0).stretch(36.0));

components.name: Now Playing
components.description: A now-playing bar that opens into a full player and folds back as one piece.

components.name: Slosh Slider
components.description: A slider whose fill has weight: drag fast and the liquid sloshes past the handle before settling.

components.name: Stacked Bars
components.description: A month of visits as stacked bars: run along them and one day is ringed while a tooltip glides beside it; Day / Week regrows the bars.

components.name: Emoji Reactions
components.description: Press the button and the message turns into a pill of emoji; pick one and it flies down to its chip as the count rolls up.

components.name: Voice Note
components.description: Hold to record a waveform, slide left to bin it, let go to play it back.

components.name: Time Scrubber
components.description: Drag the ruler to set a time; fling it and it coasts with momentum to the nearest step.

components.name: Label Input
components.description: A field whose label rests inside like a placeholder and lifts into the top edge, opening a notch in the outline, when you focus it.

components.name: Step Player
components.description: Press play and each step fills as a bar, then eases on to the next dot.

components.name: Glass Bubble
components.description: Drag a ball of glass over a picture: it magnifies the middle, bends the rim and splits the colours at the edge.

components.name: Slide to Confirm
components.description: Push the handle across; past the mark it takes over, finishes itself and turns into a check.

components.name: Pull to Refresh
components.description: Pull the card down and it stretches while a ring of dots fills in; let go past the line to refresh.

components.name: Escape Button
components.description: A button that slides away from your cursor a few times, and then gives up.

components.name: Create Menu
components.description: Press the pill and it pours open into the create menu it was all along, items rising in one by one.

components.name: Slingshot
components.description: Pull the ball back: the band stretches, locks and trembles at its limit; let go and it flies, bounces off the walls and comes home.

components.name: Asset Swap
components.description: Flip the arrow to reverse the swap on a bouncy spring; tap a coin to pick another asset.

components.name: Like
components.description: Press the heart: it pops with a burst while the count rolls up a digit.

components.name: Eye Tracker
components.description: Two eyes on a soft cube turn to follow your cursor around the block, and blink now and then.

components.name: Todo Tower
components.description: A to-do list stacked like bricks; tick one off and it slides out while the rest drop into the gap.
components.code: ui.add(TodoTower::new(["Water the plants", "Ship the release", "Call the bank"]).gravity(0.5));

components.name: Action Node
components.description: An automation step card with its controls folded into the corner; hover and they fan out one by one.

components.name: Assignees
components.description: Assign people from a list and their faces stack up in the pill above it.

components.name: Palette
components.description: A set of colours that go together; press for a new palette and it washes across, swatch by swatch.

components.name: Dragging Ball
components.description: A ball you grab: it swells under the pointer, squeezes as you hold it and wobbles home when you let go.

components.name: Notification Badge
components.description: A count badge slides out of the bell's shoulder, swells past full size on a springy curve and sharpens; it ducks away quickly when cleared.

components.name: Menu Dropdown
components.description: A dropdown opens from its top edge, scaling up from 97% while fading in on a long smooth curve, and closes faster than it opened.

components.name: Dropdown Menu Morph
components.description: A round plus button stretches into the menu it opens on a springy curve; the plus spins away as the rows slide in, and closing tucks it back with a small nudge.

components.name: Modal Open Close
components.description: A dialog pops in from 96% while fading on a long smooth curve, and leaves in about half the time.
components.code:
ui.add(PopModal::new(open)
    .title("Delete project?")
    .body("This removes the project and its files for everyone.")
    .actions("Cancel", "Delete"));

components.name: Panel Reveal
components.description: A panel rises out of a clipped edge below its trigger, sliding up from half its height while it sharpens and fades in.

components.name: Icon Swap
components.description: An icon button swaps icons in place: the old one shrinks to a quarter, blurs and fades while the new one grows out of the same spot.
components.code:
ui.add(SwapIcon::new(&mut open, SwapIconPair::MenuClose));
ui.add(SwapIcon::new(&mut playing, SwapIconPair::PlayPause).duration(0.25));

components.name: Success Check
components.description: A green disc bobs up on a springy curve, spinning back from an angle as it sharpens out of a heavy blur, and its check draws itself a beat later.

components.name: Avatar Group Hover
components.description: Overlapping avatars lift toward the pointer: the hovered face rises and grows, its neighbours rise less and less, and they drop back with a quick springy bounce.

components.name: Error State Shake
components.description: On a failed submit the field shakes with decaying swings, its outline turns red and a message fades in, then both ease back to neutral.
components.code: ui.add(ShakeField::new(&mut email).error("Please enter a valid email.").attempt(attempts));

components.name: Input Clear With Dissolve
components.description: Pressing clear dissolves the query: the characters drift down and break into dust from the button outward, a soft haze blooms and the placeholder fades back.

components.name: Skeleton Loader And Reveal
components.description: A skeleton row breathes while it waits, then the real avatar and text fade up out of a slight blur as the skeleton melts away.

components.name: Tooltip Open Close
components.description: One tooltip shared by a row of buttons: it fades and grows in after a short delay, then glides and resizes between neighbours instead of blinking.

components.name: Toast Open Close
components.description: A toast rises 16 points into place, growing from 97% and un-blurring on a long smooth curve; it leaves the way it came, a little quicker.

components.name: Learn More Hover
components.description: On hover the chevron leans forward: it nudges right while its arms splay open, optionally growing a shaft into an arrow.

components.name: Banner Stacking
components.description: New banners rise in at the front while the others step back, smaller, dimmer and softer, peeking out above; the stack fans out into a list on hover.

components.name: Checkbox Check
components.description: The box fills in quickly, then the tick draws itself end to end on a long smooth curve; unchecking erases it fast.

components.name: Matrix Dot Loader
components.description: Tiny 4 x 4 dot matrices that flash dot by dot in scan, twinkle, orbit and pulse patterns.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A switch whose pill thumb double-bounces: it overshoots the far end, swings back a hair and settles while the track flips color instantly.

components.name: Live Island
components.description: A black pill at the top of the screen that springs open into a live activity card and stretches to show notices.

components.name: Preview Menu
components.description: Touch and hold a photo: the grid frosts over, the photo springs into a large preview and a menu unfolds; slide onto an action and let go.

components.name: Reorder List
components.description: Drag a row by its grip: it lifts with a shadow, follows the finger with rubber-banded ends, and the other rows spring out of its way.
components.code:
let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Inbox", "12 messages"), TouchRow::new("Today", "")];
ui.add(ReorderList::new(&mut rows).bounce(40.0).lift(50.0));

state.name: rows
state.decl: let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Inbox", "12 messages"), TouchRow::new("Today", "")];

components.name: Swipe Actions
components.description: Mail rows that slide to reveal Flag, Delete and Pin; over-drag rubber-bands, and a long swipe stretches Delete across the row and collapses it.
components.code:
let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Maya Chen", "Dinner on Friday?")];
ui.add(SwipeActions::new(&mut rows).full_swipe(true).resistance(50.0));

state.name: rows
state.decl: let mut rows = vec![TouchRow::new("Maya Chen", "Dinner on Friday?")];

components.name: Selection List
components.description: Tap Select: rows slide aside in a cascade for round checkboxes, a floating toolbar rises, and a sweep down the checkbox column selects a run.
components.code:
let mut notes = vec![TouchRow::new("Groceries", "Milk, eggs, bread")];
ui.add(SelectionList::new(&mut notes).title("Notes").cascade(40.0));

state.name: notes
state.decl: let mut notes = vec![TouchRow::new("Groceries", "Milk, eggs, bread")];

components.name: Search Reveal
components.description: A search field tucked above a list: pull down and it unfolds, stop halfway and it snaps; the list flicks with momentum and rubber-bands at both ends.

components.name: Swipe Image Viewer
components.description: A photo grid that grows into a full-screen viewer: swipe to page with rubber-banded edges, double-tap to zoom, drag down to fling it home.

components.name: Tear Ticket
components.description: A train ticket whose stub tears off like paper: the perforation gives hole by hole, the corner peels, and a freed stub flutters away before a new one prints.

components.name: Meniscus
components.description: A drop of liquid glass that pulls free of its dock and melts into whatever it touches, refracting and colour-fringing the pool beneath; tap to frost it.
components.code: ui.add(Meniscus::new("Lido, four o'clock", "Pool floor, lane four, clear glass"));

components.name: Plush Tile
components.description: An app-icon tile covered in thousands of short combed strands that carry a mark in the pile; the fur parts under the pointer and stirs in a breeze.

components.name: Arc Picker
components.description: Options sit on the rim of a big wheel, turned to follow the curve; roll it and the chosen one lights up between springy brackets.

components.name: Wheel Picker
components.description: An iOS-style drum picker: columns roll under the finger, rows tip away toward the rim and click into a raised middle band.

components.name: Sortable Stack
components.description: Grab a task by its grip: it lifts off the stack while the others glide out of its way, and settles into its new slot when dropped.
components.code: ui.add(SortableStack::new(&mut tasks).heading("In the studio", "Make room for what matters."));

components.name: Card Dealer
components.description: A deck deals cards that arc into a fanned hand, flipping face up in flight; sort, shuffle and collect send every card gliding on its own springs.

components.name: Bloom Menu
components.description: A Create pill blooms into a grid of actions: its box morphs open, the label glides into the title, the plus turns into the close cross and tiles pop in.

components.name: Expandable Action Bar
components.description: An icon toolbar that ripples open into labelled actions with keyboard hints; badges ride along and one highlight glides between actions.

components.name: Expandable Control
components.description: Round icon buttons that spring open into labelled pills, and chips that grow a remove cross when picked.

components.name: Morphing Search
components.description: A frosted search bar floating over a gallery rises into a panel of recent searches when focused, rows sliding in under a gliding highlight.

components.name: Bouncy Accordion
components.description: Rows share one rounded block until one opens: it breaks away into its own card, gaps and corners springing around it as its text drops in with a bounce.

components.name: Overflow Actions
components.description: A pill of actions with a round more button: press it and the hidden actions slide out one by one as the pill stretches and the dots fold into a cross.

components.name: Swipeable List
components.description: Swipe a row left to slide it over snooze and delete; fling it and it flies off while the rows below spring up to close the gap.

components.name: Dock
components.description: A macOS-style dock: icons magnify around the pointer, show a label and bounce when clicked.

components.name: Marquee
components.description: Infinite scrolling strips of any content with faded edges; hover to pause, reverse for variety.

components.name: Animated List
components.description: Items pop in one after another, newest on top, pushing older ones down: a live notification feed.

components.name: Stack
components.description: A draggable card stack: fling the top card away and it tucks itself in at the back.

components.name: Card Swap
components.description: A skewed 3D stack that cycles: the front card drops away and reappears at the back.

components.name: Bounce Cards
components.description: A fan of cards bounces in one by one; hovering straightens a card and pushes its neighbors aside.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Drag or swipe between items that snap into place on a spring; neighbors peek in and dots track position.

components.name: Ring Carousel
components.description: Cards on a rotating 3D ring with real perspective. Drag to spin; it coasts and drifts when idle.

components.name: Folder
components.description: A folder that opens on click: the flap tilts down, papers fan out and lean toward the pointer.

components.name: Elastic Slider
components.description: Drag past either end and the track stretches like rubber, then snaps back with a wobble.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: A multi-step flow with animated indicators, sliding step content and a height that springs to fit.

components.name: Animated Tabs
components.description: A highlight springs between tabs, stretching as it travels; a softer hover highlight follows the pointer.

components.name: Expandable Card
components.description: Compact cards grow in place into a detail panel over a dimmed backdrop, and shrink back on close.

components.name: Flowing Menu
components.description: Hovering a row floods it with a contrasting band, entering from the pointer's side, carrying a marquee.

components.name: Gooey Nav
components.description: The active pill slides to the clicked item while colorful particles burst out and melt back in.

components.name: Orbiting Circles
components.description: Icons circle a center on concentric rings, each ring with its own speed and direction.

components.name: Animated Beam
components.description: Glowing gradient pulses travel along curved paths between nodes: data flowing through a system.

components.name: Infinite Scroll
components.description: An endless, wrapping vertical list: scroll or drag with inertia, or let it drift. Edges fade out.

components.name: Masonry
components.description: A masonry grid whose tiles glide to their new places on springs whenever the layout changes.

components.name: Presence & Transitions
components.description: Animate content in and out on a spring (fade, slide, scale, pop), and switch panels with transitions.

components.name: Animated Content
components.description: Wrap anything and it slides, scales and fades into place as it scrolls into view.

components.name: Fade Content
components.description: Content starts soft, ghosted and transparent, then sharpens into focus when it scrolls into view.

components.name: Scroll Stack
components.description: Cards pin near the top as you scroll and pile into a stack, each one shrinking back under the next.

components.name: Gradual Blur
components.description: A progressive blur at the edge of a scroller: content softens and fades in steps as it leaves.

components.name: Apple Cards Carousel
components.description: Tall full-bleed image cards in a scrolling row; clicking one morphs it into a large detail dialog.

components.name: Container Scroll
components.description: A device mockup tilted back like an opening laptop lid rotates flat as it scrolls into view.

components.name: Hero Parallax
components.description: Rows of product tiles start tilted and faded in 3D, then rotate flat and slide in opposite directions as you scroll.
components.code:
let products: Vec<_> = names.iter().map(|n| ParallaxProduct::new(*n)).collect();
ui.add(HeroParallax::new(&products).title("The Ultimate\ndevelopment studio"));

components.name: Images Slider
components.description: Full-bleed slides cross-fade with a zoom-in entrance and a slow Ken Burns push, under a headline and call to action.
components.code:
ui.add(
    ImagesSlider::new()
        .textures(&slides)
        .interval(4.0)
        .title("The hero section slideshow\nnobody asked for")
        .action("Join now"),
);

components.name: Sticky Scroll Reveal
components.description: Text sections scroll past a sticky panel that swaps its content and tints the backdrop for each one.

components.name: Pixel Image
components.description: An image resolves from a few big pixels to full detail: tiles pop in, then the mosaic sharpens step by step.

components.name: Gemini Effect
components.description: Five flowing colored curves draw themselves in, converging on a central pill and fanning out again. Bind progress to scroll.

components.name: Tracing Beam
components.description: A gradient beam beside the content that fills as you scroll, with a glowing head on a spring and a dot that lights up. Scrolls itself when idle.

components.name: Icon Cloud
components.description: A sphere of icon tiles rotating in 3D, scaled and faded by depth. It drifts toward the pointer; drag to fling it.

components.name: Card Resize
components.description: A card glides between two sizes on a long smooth curve, its skeleton bars and wrapped text reflowing live as it moves.

components.name: Page Side By Side
components.description: A two-page card: picking a token drifts the list left and blurs it out while the amount page drifts in from the right, and the card eases to its new height.

components.name: Draggable Marquee
components.description: A looping strip of portrait images that cruises on its own; grab it, fling it, and it coasts on momentum with cards leaning into the speed.

components.name: Parallax Slider
components.description: An endless strip of tall frames: drag, flick or scroll and each picture drifts against the motion inside its frame; titles rise on hover once still.

components.name: Lens Gallery
components.description: An endless wall of photos seen through a fisheye: drag and fling to pan while every tile bows through the barrel lens.

components.name: Clothes Line
components.description: Pictures pegged to a sagging rope that drifts past; every card is a pendulum, so they swing and settle as the line speeds up or stops.

components.name: Aperture Zoom
components.description: A hero that starts as a small rounded window onto an image and opens like a camera aperture as you scroll, the headline's words sliding apart.

components.name: Zoom Reveal
components.description: A small pill of footage between two words opens into a full-bleed frame as the page scrolls, the words riding its edges out and a play label surfacing.

components.name: Marble Scroll
components.description: A scroll story of full-bleed pictures whose seams tear and melt into marbling as they cross the view, strongest when scrolling fast.

components.name: Step Path
components.description: Process steps joined by one dashed line hopping dot to dot; it draws in on scroll, steps fading up as it arrives, then a darker stretch travels along it.

components.name: Gallery Tunnel
components.description: An endless flight through a square wireframe tunnel lined with images and bold color panels; click or hold to accelerate, the pointer steers the view.

components.name: Spiral Images
components.description: Image cards flow along an Archimedean spiral from the edge into the center, shrinking and turning as they are drawn into the vortex; hover to slow it.

components.name: Coverflow Gallery
components.description: A 3D coverflow carousel: the active slide faces you, neighbours swing back in perspective with a floor reflection; autoplays, drag or click to move.

components.name: Spring Playground
components.description: Tune stiffness, damping and mass and watch a ball spring after the pointer (or a hopping target), with its step response plotted live.
components.code:
let pos: Pos2 = animate(ui, id, target, Transition::spring(stiffness, damping).mass(mass));
// any Animatable works: f32, Vec2, Pos2, Rect, Color32, Props, or your own type

components.name: Easing Visualizer
components.description: Every classic easing curve plotted with a dot riding along it, so you can feel the difference.
components.code:
let x = animate(ui, id, target, Transition::tween(0.6).ease(Easing::OutBack));
let k = Easing::InOutCubic.apply(progress);

components.name: Keyframes
components.description: Values passing through several stops with per-segment easing, infinite repeats, yoyo vs mirror, and repeat delays.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: A GSAP-style timeline: tweens sequenced with relative positions, labels and overlaps; play, pause, reverse, change speed or scrub.

components.name: Motion Box
components.description: A container like motion.div: enter from initial props, hover and tap states, and spring to new targets. Its children stay fully interactive.

components.name: Variants & Stagger
components.description: Switch one variant name and every child follows, staggered one after another (from the first, or from the center outward).

components.name: Presence
components.description: Content that animates out before it disappears: auto-dismissing toasts and a keyed list where items enter, exit and the rest slide into place.
components.code:
Presence::new(id, visible)
    .initial(Props::new().opacity(0.0).y(-12.0))
    .exit(Props::new().opacity(0.0).x(40.0))
    .show(ui, |ui| ui.label("Saved!"));

PresenceList::new(id)
    .initial(Props::new().opacity(0.0).x(-30.0))
    .exit(Props::new().opacity(0.0).scale(0.8))
    .show(ui, &items, |item| item.id, |ui, item| { ui.label(&item.name); });

components.name: Layout Animation
components.description: Items glide between layouts (grid ↔ list, shuffle) instead of jumping: FLIP-style layout animation keyed by identity.

components.name: Shared Element
components.description: A thumbnail expands into a detail view and back: the same key used in two places animates between them (layoutId).

components.name: Drag & Snap
components.description: Throw a puck around with momentum and elastic edges, snap a knob to stops along an axis, and pull a card that springs home.
components.code:
Draggable::new(id)
    .constraints(area)          // stay inside
    .elastic(0.35)              // rubber-band past the edges
    .momentum(true)             // glide on release, bounce back in
    .while_drag(Props::new().scale(1.12))
    .show(ui, |ui| puck(ui));

Draggable::new(id2).axis(Axis::X).snap_points([vec2(-120.0, 0.0), Vec2::ZERO, vec2(120.0, 0.0)]).show(ui, knob);

components.name: Reorder List
components.description: Drag rows to reorder them; the others slide out of the way and the dragged row lifts above them.

components.name: Scroll-Linked Motion
components.description: A progress bar tied to scroll position, parallax layers at different speeds, values mapped with transform(), and cards that animate in when scrolled into view.

components.name: Motion Path
components.description: Objects travel along a smooth path, turning to follow its tangent, with a comet trail and a staggered convoy.

components.name: Path Drawing
components.description: Any polyline drawn progressively with a gradient stroke and a glowing pen tip, then erased: like animating SVG pathLength.

components.name: Lanyard
components.description: An ID badge hanging on a strap simulated with a verlet rope. Grab it, swing it, fling it.

components.name: Shape Morph
components.description: Outlines morph smoothly between circle, square, star, heart and blob: resampled, aligned and interpolated point by point.
components.code:
ui.add(MorphShape::new().size(220.0));
let mid = morph_polygon(&star, &heart, t);   // any two polygons

components.name: Spring Chain
components.description: A follow-the-leader chain of springs: each dot chases the one in front, making whippy trails behind the pointer.

components.name: Flying Posters

components.description: Six-digit code entry that auto-verifies, shakes on a wrong code, shows success and offers a resend countdown. Try 424242.

components.name: 404 Not Found
components.description: A giant floating gradient 404 over drifting particles, message, docs search, two actions and quick-link cards.
components.code:
let r = NotFoundPage::new().background(SectionBackground::Particles).show(ui);
if r.clicked("Go back home") { /* route */ }

components.name: 500 Server Error
components.description: Glitching 500 with a pulsing error pill, retry button with loading state and a service-status card with uptime bars.

components.name: Coming Soon / Maintenance
components.description: Launch countdown with sliding seconds, notify-me form and socials over aurora; maintenance mode swaps in a progress bar.

components.name: Onboarding Wizard
components.description: Four-step onboarding: stepper, profile with role tiles, workspace with generated URL, theme preview tiles and switches, team invites, validation and a finish screen.

components.name: Waitlist Page
components.description: Pre-launch page: floating header, waitlist form with live counter over meteors, teaser features and a simple footer.

components.name: Contact Page
components.description: Contact page: header, validated contact form with details, FAQ and footer.

components.name: Blog Post
components.description: Article page: category, title, author meta and share buttons, cover, prose with headings, quote, code, list, figure and callout, author card, related posts and newsletter.
components.code:
BlogPostPage::new("Designing motion that feels native")
    .author("Mia Park", "Head of Design")
    .body(ArticleBlock::defaults())
    .show(ui);

components.name: Profile Page
components.description: User profile: cover art, overlapping avatar with status, follow toggle, counting stats, tabs with pinned projects, skills, achievements, contribution graph and activity feed.
components.code:
let r = ProfilePage::new("Ava Chen", "@ava").bio("Design engineer.").show(ui);
if r.clicked("Follow") { /* ... */ }

components.name: Thank You Page
components.description: Success page: self-drawing check with a confetti burst, order summary, next steps and two actions.

components.name: Analytics Dashboard
components.description: KPI tiles with sparklines, revenue area chart, traffic donut, top pages and recent orders, with date-range tabs that reload the data behind skeletons.
components.code:
let mut app = AnalyticsApp::default(); // store in your app state
app.show(ui);

components.name: SaaS Admin / CRM
components.description: Customers table with search, filters, sortable columns, selection and bulk delete, a detail sheet and an add dialog; a drag-and-drop deal pipeline.

components.name: Sales Pipeline Board
components.description: The CRM's deal pipeline: stage columns with counts and totals, deal cards you drag between stages, and toasts when a deal moves or is won.

components.name: E-commerce Admin
components.description: Store admin with a low-stock alert, KPIs, order tabs and one-click fulfil; a filterable product grid with featured stars; inventory levels with reordering.

components.name: Product Catalog Grid
components.description: The store's product grid: search, category chips, sort, grid / list toggle, stock badges, ratings and featured stars, with hover lift.

components.name: Finance Dashboard
components.description: Gradient balance card, account cards with sparklines, cash-flow bars, spending vs. budget, filterable transactions and a working transfer dialog.

components.name: Project Management
components.description: Project header with progress and team, collapsible status groups with completable tasks, priorities and due dates; Ctrl+2 flips to a drag-and-drop board.

components.name: Task Board
components.description: The project's board view: status columns, task cards with labels, priority flags, sub-task progress and assignees; drag cards between columns.

components.name: Mail Client
components.description: Three panes: folders with live unread counts, a searchable list with All / Unread tabs, a reading pane with actions and inline reply; ↑ ↓ E Del C shortcuts and a compose dialog.

components.name: Team Chat
components.description: Dual sidebar of channels and DMs, a message stream with day divider, grouped messages, toggleable reactions and threads, and a composer where teammates type back.

components.name: AI Assistant
components.description: Chat history in the sidebar, a conversation with streamed reasoning and Markdown answers, message actions, suggestions, attachments and a model picker in the composer.

components.name: Settings Pages
components.description: Profile, account, notifications, appearance (a theme picker that installs real themes, radius and density), billing plan cards with yearly pricing, and team roles.

components.name: Billing & Plans
components.description: The settings billing page: plan cards with a monthly / yearly switch, upgrade and downgrade actions, payment method and downloadable invoices.

components.name: File Manager
components.description: Folder tree with storage meter, breadcrumbs, search, grid / list toggle, double-click to open folders, and a details panel with preview, metadata and sharing.

components.name: Music Player
components.description: Library sidebar, playlist hero, track list with live equalizer bars and likes, an up-next queue and a now-playing bar with seek, volume, shuffle and repeat (Space, ← →).

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Mini month picker and calendar toggles, Month / Week views (M / W, ← →, T), event chips with +n more, positioned week blocks with a now line, and click-to-create.

components.name: Docs / Knowledge Base
components.description: Grouped page tree, an article with breadcrumbs, callouts and code, a scroll-synced table of contents, prev / next cards and a helpful-or-not prompt.

components.name: Developer Console
components.description: Usage page with KPI tiles, request and error charts and a 90-day uptime tracker; API keys with a reveal-once create dialog and revoke confirmation; a live log stream.

components.name: Live Log Stream
components.description: The developer console's log viewer: a pulsing live badge, level toggles, filter, pause / resume (P), auto-follow scrolling and highlighted errors.

components.name: Auth Gate & Sign-in
components.description: Signed-out state of an app: the shell stays, content becomes a sign-in card with OAuth buttons, validation, remember me and a loading sign-in that unlocks the workspace.
components.code:
let mut app = AuthGateApp::default(); // signed_in = false
app.show(ui);

components.name: Gated Empty States
components.description: Signed-in gates: an upgrade wall over a frosted preview (Reports), access denied with request access (Admin) and a first-run empty state that seeds sample data (Projects).

components.name: Agent Sessions
components.description: Supervise coding-agent sessions across your machines: live / needs-input / idle states grouped by device, a streaming transcript with tool calls, a diff panel, an approve / deny bar, usage limits and a new-session composer (Ctrl+N, Enter / Esc).

components.name: Agent Fleet Manager
components.description: Skills, plugins, MCP servers and projects for coding agents: search, filter tabs, cards with install progress and enable switches, update badges and a details drawer (Esc closes).

components.name: MCP Server Health
components.description: The fleet manager's MCP servers: live latency sparklines, degraded and down states with reconnect countdowns, transport and tool counts, restart from the drawer.

components.name: Local LLM Chat
components.description: A desktop front end for local models: streaming chat with live tokens/sec, context and first-token readouts, a model switcher that loads into VRAM (Ctrl+L), system-prompt presets (Alt+1..4), sampling sliders and RAM / VRAM / GPU meters.

components.name: Local Model Library
components.description: The local LLM app's model library: hardware tiles, quantization picks with sizes, fits-in-VRAM hints, downloads with progress, speed and ETA, and one-click load.

components.name: Trading Terminal
components.description: A live trading terminal: candlesticks with EMA / Bollinger / volume, crosshair, wheel zoom and drag pan; an order book with depth bars and flashing levels, a trade tape, positions with live PnL, order entry (B / S, limit / market) and a watchlist with sparklines.
components.code:
let mut app = TradingTerminalApp::default(); // dark by default
app.show(ui);

components.name: Profiler / Inspector
components.description: A developer profiler for a running process: live frame-time chart with budget lines, a collapsible span tree, a zoomable flame graph (wheel, drag, double-click to fit, F resets), a property inspector with per-frame history and a filterable log console (Space pauses, ← → step frames).

components.name: Game HUD
components.description: A full shooter / RPG HUD over a live scene: health and mana with damage trails, ability cooldowns, ammo, minimap, kill feed and a dynamic crosshair, all driven by simulated gameplay.

components.name: Main Menu
components.description: A title screen over a parallax scene: the title drops in letter by letter and breathes with a glow, entries stagger in and slide on hover, and every hover / confirm is reported as a sound cue.

components.name: Pause Menu
components.description: A pause overlay: the running scene slows to a stop and dims into a vignette while the panel springs in with play info and staggered menu entries.

components.name: Settings Panel
components.description: Tabbed game settings for graphics, audio and controls: segmented sliders, springy toggles, arrow selectors and key rebind rows that capture the next key you press.
components.code:
let mut settings = GameSettings::default();
ui.add(GameSettingsPanel::new(&mut settings).style(GameStyle::SciFi).cues(&mut cues));

components.name: Health & Mana Bars
components.description: Health, mana and stamina bars in three skins: damage cuts the fill and leaves a delayed trail that drains after a beat (with sparks and shake), heals pour in with a green ghost and rising pluses, low health pulses red.

components.name: Boss Bar
components.description: A wide boss health bar with the name glowing above, phase notches that fire a flash, ring and sparks when crossed, an armor layer and an enraged pulse in the final phase.

components.name: Minimap
components.description: Round and square minimaps with procedural terrain, fog of war that clears along the explored trail, a player arrow with view cone, pulsing enemies, rippling pings and objectives pinned to the rim.

components.name: Ammo Counter
components.description: Magazine and reserve counters: each shot kicks the number and ejects a spinning casing, low ammo pulses amber, an empty magazine flashes RELOAD and the reload sweeps rounds back in.

components.name: Cooldown Icons
components.description: Ability slots with a radial cooldown sweep, a bright hand on the edge and seconds left; coming off cooldown flashes white, pops on a spring and throws a ring of sparks.

components.name: Hotbar
components.description: Item hotbars where the selected slot springs up and grows with a glow beneath, its name popping up above; select by click, scroll wheel or number keys.

components.name: Inventory Grid
components.description: Drag-and-drop inventory: items glow by rarity (legendaries run a light beam around their slot), lift out with a lagging tilt, swap with a springy landing, and show a tooltip card comparing stats with your equipped gear.

components.name: Item Tooltip
components.description: Item tooltip cards with a rarity-tinted header, stats compared to the equipped item (green and red arrows with deltas) and flavor text, in all three skins.

components.name: Skill Tree
components.description: A skill tree where unlocking sends a surge of energy down the link before the node pops, rings and sparkles alight; available links shimmer, locked ones stay faint, and hovering shows a card.

components.name: Dialogue Box
components.description: An RPG dialogue box with a painted portrait that blinks and talks, a name plate, typewriter text with a glowing caret, and player choices that stagger in when the line finishes.
components.code:
ui.add(GameDialogueBox::new(&line)
    .chosen(&mut choice)
    .advance(&mut next)
    .cues(&mut cues)); // GameCue::Type per letter for blips

components.name: Quest Tracker
components.description: A HUD quest tracker: new quests slide in flagged NEW, counts pop as they go up, finished objectives tick with a burst and a sweeping strike-through, and completed quests light up with a banner.

components.name: Quest Log
components.description: A quest journal: main and side quests on the left with a gliding highlight, the selected quest's story, objectives with filling progress bars and rewards on the right.

components.name: Loot Popup
components.description: A loot reveal: an orb in the rarity color charges and trembles, then bursts into a flash, shock rings, particles and god rays as the item card springs out with its stats.

components.name: Achievement Toast
components.description: Achievement toasts that drop in on a spring, pop their badge with a ring and sparks, sweep a sheen across the card and count down before sliding away.

components.name: Damage Numbers
components.description: Floating combat text over a training target: normal hits pop and arc away, crits slam in golden with a starburst and shake, heals rise green, misses slide off. Click the scene to land crits.

components.name: Crosshairs
components.description: A set of dynamic crosshairs (cross, dot, circle, chevron, brackets, scope) that open on a spring as spread grows, with white hit markers and red kill markers.

components.name: Loading Screen
components.description: A loading screen with drifting level art, the level name in the corner, rotating gameplay tips, a progress bar with a moving sheen, a styled spinner and a pulsing prompt at 100%.

components.name: Level Up Screen
components.description: A level-up moment: rays wheel open, LEVEL UP slams in letter by letter with a shake, the level number rolls over, confetti bursts and stat gains pop in one by one.

components.name: Kill Feed
components.description: A kill feed where new kills punch in from the right with a flash, old ones fade and the rest glide up; headshots get a skull and your own kills a bright frame.

components.name: Scoreboard
components.description: A two-team scoreboard: rows stagger in, re-sort with springy moves as scores change (the new score pops), the local player glows, dead players dim with a skull and ping shows as signal bars.

components.name: Character Select
components.description: A hero select carousel: cards ride a spring along an arc with the chosen one tall and glowing, the scene tints to the hero's color, stat bars refill and the confirm button breathes.

glowkit-effects::MagicBento.name: MagicBento

grid.
